Question: Assalamualaikum, I would like to know about the dream which i saw, I had asked a question about my dream and I got a reply from you. Jazakallah.Fatwa ID: Fatwa: 1294/1294=H/1429. Question : 5843. The day when I read the answer posted by you, I was happy that my previous dream showed a good sign, on the same day I thanked Allah & did istagfaar and slept. I saw a dream that I am walking in Masjid Nabai towards rowza of Huzoor (SAS), As i went nearer & nearer, my heart beats started very fast, somekind of fear increased in my heart(like i was feeling "mai kya cehra leke huzoor ke saamnay khadoun"), I think i walked till the old mimber of masjid-e-nabawi, and started crying and suddenly I woke up, its was around 4.30 am. I am very much worried, why i was not able to go infront of roza of Huzoor(SAS), is this a good sign or a bad, I am very much worried about it and wil be thinking always why I saw that dream, please breaf me on this, and pray for me. Answer ID: 7145 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1372/1287=D/1429) It is a blessed dream. The fear was caused due to greatness and love which prevented from marching ahead. It is a good sign. Recite durood as much as you can and strive hard to follow Sunnah. In-sha-Allah, you shall observe its blessings with open eyes. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
